onboard.title: Today's to-do
round.PrimHavuzu.name: Bonus Pool
round.PrimHavuzu.rule: You're paired up: secretly Share or Take It All.
round.PrimHavuzu.example: Both share: –1 blame each. One takes: the taker –4, the sharer +2.
round.PrimHavuzu.long.1: One takes, one shares: the taker –4, the sharer +2.
round.PrimHavuzu.long.2: Both take: +1 each. With an odd head count, one group is a trio.
round.FarkliEposta.name: Odd Email
round.FarkliEposta.rule: Everyone got the same email — except one. Find them; if it's you, blend in.
round.FarkliEposta.example: Example: everyone's talking about Friday's party, and one person mentions an office cat...
round.FarkliEposta.long.0: If most people pick the odd one: they get +3, correct voters –1.
round.FarkliEposta.long.1: If not: the odd one gets –2, and whoever was wrongly picked +2.
round.FarkliEposta.long.2: Even if caught, the odd one only gets +1 by guessing the others' topic.
round.KayipRapor.name: Lost Report
round.KayipRapor.rule: Someone lost the report. Everyone holds one true 'X is innocent' slip — the culprit lies.
round.KayipRapor.example: Example: if your slip says 'Pink is innocent', cross Pink off and compare slips on the phone.
round.KayipRapor.long.0: If most people find the culprit: they get +3, correct voters –1.
round.KayipRapor.long.1: If not: the culprit gets –2, and whoever was wrongly picked +2.
round.KayipRapor.long.2: One or two innocents have no alibi — and the culprit knows who.
round.IhbarKutusu.name: Complaint Box
round.IhbarKutusu.example: Example: 'Microwaved fish.' The author isn't named. (Usually.)
round.IhbarKutusu.long.1: If any complaint was filed, everyone with none gets –1.
round.IhbarKutusu.long.2: Sometimes the manager leaks an author at the meeting.
round.TerfiListesi.name: Promotion List
round.TerfiListesi.rule: Recommend one colleague for promotion — publicly.
round.TerfiListesi.example: Example: whoever gets the most backing gets –3 blame; their backers –1.
round.TerfiListesi.long.0: Most recommendations: –3 blame. A tie means nobody.
round.OrtakSifre.name: Shared Password
round.OrtakSifre.rule: Each of you holds one digit of the server password. One of you is lying.
round.OrtakSifre.example: Example: you know digit 3 (a 7) and your right-hand neighbour's. Gather the rest by phone and lock in one code.
round.OrtakSifre.long.0: If more than half of you lock in the exact code: everyone –1, the saboteur +2.
round.OrtakSifre.long.2: The saboteur may lie about their digit; check it from two sources.

trick.FisCek.hit_sub: Someone pulled your plug. Give it a minute.
